description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Modifier class, which compiles code for executing modifiers within the Smarty template engine. It defines the 'compile' method that processes a list of modifiers and generates corresponding PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Modifier
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling code to execute modifiers in Smarty templates, extending the base compilation class.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to execute a list of modifiers on a given value, handling different types of modifiers such as registered plugins, compiler plugins, callable PHP functions, and default handlers.
